svg.title: Scenario 1: Enemy Turn — Goblin Executes Basic Attack on Warrior

g.text: Scenario 1: Enemy Turn — Goblin Executes Basic Attack on Warrior
SpeedBasedTurnOrder sorts all combatants by speed DESC.
Warrior (SPD 30) acts first, Goblin (SPD 25) acts second.
Both phases occur inside a single executePlayerTurn() call.
This diagram focuses on the Goblin (enemy) phase.
